words.definitionEn: the amount of carbon dioxide that a person or activity produces
words.exampleEn: Cycling to work is an easy way to reduce your carbon footprint.
words.exampleUz: Ishga velosipedda borish uglerod izini kamaytirishning oson yo'li.

words.definitionEn: a gas such as carbon dioxide that traps heat in the atmosphere
words.exampleEn: Factories and cars release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
words.exampleUz: Zavodlar va avtomobillar atmosferaga issiqxona gazlarini chiqaradi.

words.definitionEn: fuel such as coal, oil or gas formed under the ground over millions of years
words.exampleEn: Our economy still depends heavily on fossil fuels.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiyotimiz hamon qazib olinadigan yoqilg'iga qattiq bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: all the plants and animals in an area and the way they affect each other
words.exampleEn: Draining the lake destroyed the whole ecosystem.
words.exampleUz: Ko'lni quritish butun ekotizimni yo'q qildi.

words.definitionEn: the natural place where an animal or plant normally lives
words.exampleEn: New roads are destroying the natural habitat of many birds.
words.exampleUz: Yangi yo'llar ko'plab qushlarning tabiiy yashash muhitini yo'q qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: animals and plants living in natural conditions
words.exampleEn: The government has opened a reserve to protect local wildlife.
words.exampleUz: Hukumat mahalliy yovvoyi tabiatni himoya qilish uchun qo'riqxona ochdi.

words.definitionEn: a long period of time with little or no rain
words.exampleEn: A severe drought destroyed most of the cotton harvest.
words.exampleUz: Qattiq qurg'oqchilik paxta hosilining ko'p qismini nobud qildi.

words.definitionEn: the supplying of water to land so that crops can grow
words.exampleEn: Outdated irrigation systems waste enormous amounts of water.
words.exampleUz: Eskirgan sug'orish tizimlari juda ko'p suvni behuda sarflaydi.

words.definitionEn: a place where rubbish is buried under the ground
words.exampleEn: Most of our plastic ends up in landfill sites outside the city.
words.exampleUz: Plastigimizning aksariyati shahar tashqarisidagi chiqindixonalarga tushadi.

words.definitionEn: to treat used objects so that they can be used again
words.exampleEn: Only a small share of household waste is recycled here.
words.exampleUz: Bu yerda maishiy chiqindilarning ozgina qismigina qayta ishlanadi.

words.definitionEn: designed to be used once and then thrown away
words.exampleEn: Several countries have banned single-use plastic bags.
words.exampleUz: Bir nechta davlat bir marta ishlatiladigan plastik paketlarni taqiqlagan.

words.definitionEn: not harmful to the environment
words.exampleEn: Consumers are willing to pay more for eco-friendly packaging.
words.exampleUz: Iste'molchilar ekologik toza qadoq uchun ko'proq to'lashga tayyor.

words.definitionEn: containing poison and very harmful to living things
words.exampleEn: Factories dump toxic waste directly into the river.
words.exampleUz: Zavodlar zaharli chiqindini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri daryoga tashlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a chemical used to kill insects that damage crops
words.exampleEn: Heavy use of pesticides has poisoned the soil.
words.exampleUz: Pestitsidlardan ko'p foydalanish tuproqni zaharlagan.

words.definitionEn: to get rid of something you no longer want
words.exampleEn: Batteries must be disposed of safely, not thrown in the bin.
words.exampleUz: Batareyalarni chelakka tashlamay, xavfsiz yo'q qilish kerak.

words.definitionEn: to make people obey a rule or law
words.exampleEn: Environmental laws exist, but nobody enforces them strictly.
words.exampleUz: Ekologik qonunlar bor, lekin ularni hech kim qat'iy amalda bajartirmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to officially say that something is not allowed
words.exampleEn: The city has banned old diesel buses from the centre.
words.exampleUz: Shahar eski dizel avtobuslarining markazga kirishini taqiqladi.

words.definitionEn: dirty air caused by smoke and fog hanging over a city
words.exampleEn: Winter smog in the capital often exceeds safe limits.
words.exampleUz: Poytaxtdagi qishki smog ko'pincha xavfsiz me'yordan oshadi.

words.definitionEn: waste water and human waste carried away in pipes
words.exampleEn: Untreated sewage flows straight into the canal.
words.exampleUz: Tozalanmagan oqova suv to'g'ri kanalga oqadi.

words.definitionEn: rubbish left lying in a public place
words.exampleEn: Volunteers collected two tonnes of litter from the riverbank.
words.exampleUz: Ko'ngillilar daryo bo'yidan ikki tonna axlat yig'di.

words.definitionEn: the situation in which a type of animal or plant no longer exists
words.exampleEn: Several fish species have been driven to extinction.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha baliq turi yo'q bo'lib ketishga mahkum etildi.

words.definitionEn: the process by which fertile land gradually becomes desert
words.exampleEn: Desertification has swallowed thousands of hectares near the Aral Sea.
words.exampleUz: Cho'llanish Orol dengizi yaqinidagi minglab gektar yerni yutdi.

words.definitionEn: to damage the quality of something, especially land or the environment
words.exampleEn: Overgrazing has badly degraded the soil in the steppe.
words.exampleUz: Haddan ortiq mol boqish dashtdagi tuproq sifatini jiddiy buzgan.

words.definitionEn: to make something dirty or dangerous by adding a harmful substance
words.exampleEn: Chemicals from the plant have contaminated the water supply.
words.exampleUz: Zavoddan chiqqan kimyoviy moddalar suv ta'minotini zaharlagan.

words.definitionEn: the gradual wearing away of soil or rock by wind and water
words.exampleEn: Cutting down forests speeds up soil erosion on the hillsides.
words.exampleUz: O'rmonlarni kesish tog' yonbag'irlarida tuproq eroziyasini tezlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: limited in amount and certain to run out one day
words.exampleEn: Oil and gas are finite resources that will not last for ever.
words.exampleUz: Neft va gaz — abadiy yetmaydigan chekli resurslar.

words.definitionEn: negative and likely to cause problems
words.exampleEn: Farmers are already feeling the adverse effects of climate change.
words.exampleUz: Dehqonlar iqlim o'zgarishining salbiy oqibatlarini allaqachon his qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to control or limit something harmful
words.exampleEn: Higher fuel taxes could curb the use of private cars.
words.exampleUz: Yoqilg'iga yuqori soliq shaxsiy avtomobillardan foydalanishni jilovlashi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to use natural resources fully, often without thinking of the future
words.exampleEn: Companies exploit natural resources with little regard for future generations.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniyalar kelajak avlodlarni o'ylamay tabiiy resurslardan ayovsiz foydalanadi.

words.definitionEn: impossible to change back to the way it was before
words.exampleEn: Scientists warn that some of the damage is already irreversible.
words.exampleUz: Olimlar zararning bir qismi allaqachon qaytarib bo'lmaydigan ekanidan ogohlantirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: pretending to be environmentally friendly for marketing reasons
words.exampleEn: Critics accused the brand of greenwashing rather than real change.
words.exampleUz: Tanqidchilar brendni haqiqiy o'zgarish o'rniga yashil niqob bilan shug'ullanishda aybladi.

words.definitionEn: the planting of trees in areas where forests have been cut down
words.exampleEn: A large reforestation programme has begun in the mountain districts.
words.exampleUz: Tog' tumanlarida katta o'rmonlarni qayta tiklash dasturi boshlandi.

words.definitionEn: the amount of salt contained in water or soil
words.exampleEn: Rising salinity has made much of the land useless for crops.
words.exampleUz: Sho'rlanishning ortishi yerning katta qismini ekin uchun yaroqsiz qildi.

words.definitionEn: land that is suitable for growing crops
words.exampleEn: The country is losing arable land to the desert every year.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakat har yili cho'lga ekin ekiladigan yerni boy bermoqda.

words.definitionEn: catching so many fish that stocks cannot recover
words.exampleEn: Overfishing has emptied the lake within a single decade.
words.exampleUz: Haddan ortiq baliq ovlash bor-yo'g'i o'n yil ichida ko'lni bo'shatdi.

words.definitionEn: the illegal hunting of protected animals
words.exampleEn: Poaching remains the biggest threat to the saiga antelope.
words.exampleUz: Brakonyerlik sayg'oq uchun eng katta tahdid bo'lib qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: not adding to the total amount of carbon dioxide in the air
words.exampleEn: The airport aims to become carbon-neutral by 2035.
words.exampleUz: Aeroport 2035-yilgacha uglerod jihatidan neytral bo'lishni maqsad qilgan.

words.definitionEn: to reduce the bad effect of something by acting against it
words.exampleEn: Planting shelter belts helps counteract soil erosion.
words.exampleUz: Ihota daraxtzorlarini ekish tuproq eroziyasiga qarshi ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: dangerous to people's health or to the environment
words.exampleEn: Hazardous waste must be stored separately from ordinary rubbish.
words.exampleUz: Xavfli chiqindi oddiy axlatdan alohida saqlanishi shart.

words.definitionEn: the burning of waste at very high temperatures
words.exampleEn: Incineration reduces the volume of waste but pollutes the air.
words.exampleUz: Chiqindini yoqib yuborish uning hajmini kamaytiradi, lekin havoni ifloslantiradi.

words.definitionEn: someone who enters computer systems illegally
words.exampleEn: Hackers stole the personal data of thousands of users.
words.exampleUz: Xakerlar minglab foydalanuvchining shaxsiy ma'lumotlarini o'g'irladi.

words.definitionEn: easy for ordinary people to use
words.exampleEn: The app succeeded because its design is user-friendly.
words.exampleUz: Ilova muvaffaqiyat qozondi, chunki uning dizayni qulay.

words.definitionEn: the ability to use digital tools confidently and safely
words.exampleEn: Digital literacy should be taught from primary school.
words.exampleUz: Raqamli savodxonlikni boshlang'ich sinfdan o'rgatish kerak.

words.definitionEn: the amount of time a person spends looking at a screen
words.exampleEn: Parents struggle to limit their children's screen time.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalar bolalarining ekran oldidagi vaqtini cheklashga qiynalmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a program that answers questions in a written conversation
words.exampleEn: The bank uses a chatbot to answer simple questions day and night.
words.exampleUz: Bank oddiy savollarga kechayu kunduz javob berish uchun chatbotdan foydalanadi.

words.definitionEn: a small useful electronic tool
words.exampleEn: Teenagers spend most of their money on new gadgets.
words.exampleUz: O'smirlar pulining ko'p qismini yangi gadjetlarga sarflaydi.

words.definitionEn: a program used to look at pages on the internet
words.exampleEn: Your browser stores a record of every site you visit.
words.exampleUz: Brauzeringiz siz kirgan har bir saytning yozuvini saqlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a program that finds information for you on the internet
words.exampleEn: Students rely on a search engine instead of the library.
words.exampleUz: Talabalar kutubxona o'rniga qidiruv tizimiga tayanadi.

words.definitionEn: keeping files on the internet rather than on your own device
words.exampleEn: Cloud storage lets you open your files from any device.
words.exampleUz: Bulutli saqlash fayllaringizni istalgan qurilmadan ochish imkonini beradi.

words.definitionEn: the activity of writing computer programs
words.exampleEn: Coding is now taught in some primary schools.
words.exampleUz: Dasturlash endi ba'zi boshlang'ich maktablarda o'rgatilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a machine that connects to the internet and works partly by itself
words.exampleEn: A modern kitchen may contain a dozen smart devices.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy oshxonada o'nlab aqlli qurilma bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: the buying and selling of goods over the internet
words.exampleEn: E-commerce has changed the way small shops survive.
words.exampleUz: Elektron tijorat kichik do'konlarning omon qolish tarzini o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: a screen that you control by touching it
words.exampleEn: Even young children can use a touchscreen easily.
words.exampleUz: Hatto yosh bolalar ham sensorli ekrandan bemalol foydalana oladi.

words.definitionEn: a short message from an app telling you that something has happened
words.exampleEn: Constant notifications make deep concentration almost impossible.
words.exampleUz: Doimiy bildirishnomalar chuqur diqqatni deyarli imkonsiz qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a phone call in which you can also see the other person
words.exampleEn: Families abroad stay close through weekly video calls.
words.exampleUz: Chet eldagi oilalar haftalik video qo'ng'iroqlar orqali yaqin qoladi.

words.definitionEn: the quality of being easy and of saving time or effort
words.exampleEn: People accept less privacy in exchange for convenience.
words.exampleUz: Odamlar qulaylik evaziga kamroq maxfiylikka rozi bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: something that stops you giving your attention to a task
words.exampleEn: The phone on the desk is the biggest distraction in class.
words.exampleUz: Partadagi telefon — darsdagi eng katta chalg'ituvchi narsa.

words.definitionEn: the use of something in a wrong or harmful way
words.exampleEn: The misuse of personal data has damaged public trust.
words.exampleUz: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni noto'g'ri ishlatish jamoatchilik ishonchiga putur yetkazdi.

words.definitionEn: easy to reach, use or understand
words.exampleEn: Technology has made education accessible to remote villages.
words.exampleUz: Texnologiya ta'limni chekka qishloqlar uchun qulay qildi.

words.definitionEn: good at understanding and using technology
words.exampleEn: Tech-savvy students often end up helping their own teachers.
words.exampleUz: Texnikani yaxshi biladigan o'quvchilar ko'pincha o'qituvchilariga yordam berib qoladi.

words.definitionEn: a method that lets computers improve from data instead of being programmed
words.exampleEn: Machine learning models are trained on huge amounts of data.
words.exampleUz: Mashinali o'qitish modellari ulkan hajmdagi ma'lumotlarda o'qitiladi.

words.definitionEn: able to operate without human control
words.exampleEn: Autonomous vehicles are already being tested on public roads.
words.exampleUz: Avtonom transport vositalari allaqachon jamoat yo'llarida sinovdan o'tkazilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: an incident in which private information is stolen or exposed
words.exampleEn: The data breach exposed millions of email addresses.
words.exampleUz: Ma'lumotlar sizib chiqishi millionlab elektron pochta manzilini oshkor qildi.

words.definitionEn: software designed to damage a system or gain access to it
words.exampleEn: Never open links that may contain malware.
words.exampleUz: Zararli dastur bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan havolalarni hech qachon ochmang.

words.definitionEn: no longer used because something newer exists
words.exampleEn: Automation could make many clerical jobs obsolete.
words.exampleUz: Avtomatlashtirish ko'plab kotiblik kasblarini eskirgan holga keltirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: causing great change to an existing industry or way of doing things
words.exampleEn: Generative AI is the most disruptive technology of the decade.
words.exampleUz: Generativ sun'iy intellekt — o'n yillikning eng katta tub o'zgarish keltiruvchi texnologiyasi.

words.definitionEn: the most modern and advanced of its kind
words.exampleEn: The laboratory works with cutting-edge technology.
words.exampleUz: Laboratoriya eng ilg'or texnologiya bilan ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: no longer needed, especially in a job
words.exampleEn: Thousands of drivers could be made redundant by self-driving lorries.
words.exampleUz: O'zi yuradigan yuk mashinalari tufayli minglab haydovchi ishdan bo'shatilishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to make a process simpler and more effective
words.exampleEn: Digital documents have streamlined the whole application process.
words.exampleUz: Raqamli hujjatlar butun ariza jarayonini soddalashtirdi.

words.definitionEn: to add something to make a thing stronger or more effective
words.exampleEn: AI should augment human judgement, not remove it.
words.exampleUz: Sun'iy intellekt inson qarorini yo'qotmasdan, kuchaytirishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to put a system or resource into use
words.exampleEn: The hospital has deployed AI software to read X-rays.
words.exampleUz: Shifoxona rentgen tasvirlarini o'qish uchun AI dasturini joriy qildi.

words.definitionEn: the state of not being known by name
words.exampleEn: Anonymity online encourages some users to behave badly.
words.exampleUz: Internetdagi anonimlik ba'zi foydalanuvchilarni yomon xatti-harakatga undaydi.

words.definitionEn: growing faster and faster over time
words.exampleEn: The exponential growth of computing power surprised even experts.
words.exampleUz: Hisoblash quvvatining keskin o'sishi hatto mutaxassislarni ham hayratda qoldirdi.

words.definitionEn: to combine one system with another so that they work together
words.exampleEn: Schools are integrating AI tools into everyday lessons.
words.exampleUz: Maktablar AI vositalarini kundalik darslarga integratsiya qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the state of depending on something too much
words.exampleEn: Over-reliance on translation apps weakens language skills.
words.exampleUz: Tarjima ilovalariga haddan ortiq bog'liqlik til ko'nikmalarini zaiflashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: a small fault that stops a system working properly
words.exampleEn: A software glitch delayed every flight for six hours.
words.exampleUz: Dasturiy nosozlik har bir reysni olti soatga kechiktirdi.

words.definitionEn: able to show what is likely to happen in the future
words.exampleEn: Predictive text sometimes changes the meaning of a message.
words.exampleUz: Bashoratli matn ba'zan xabar ma'nosini o'zgartirib yuboradi.

words.definitionEn: a small computer worn on the body, such as a smart watch
words.exampleEn: Wearables can warn users about heart problems.
words.exampleUz: Kiyiladigan qurilmalar foydalanuvchini yurak muammolaridan ogohlantira oladi.

words.definitionEn: technology that identifies a person from an image of their face
words.exampleEn: Facial recognition at stadiums worries civil rights groups.
words.exampleUz: Stadionlardagi yuzni tanish texnologiyasi huquq himoyachilarini tashvishga solmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the trail of information a person leaves behind online
words.exampleEn: Employers increasingly examine an applicant's digital footprint.
words.exampleUz: Ish beruvchilar nomzodning raqamli izini tobora ko'proq o'rganmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the money paid for teaching at a school or university
words.exampleEn: Rising tuition fees keep talented students out of higher education.
words.exampleUz: O'qish to'lovlarining oshishi iqtidorli talabalarni oliy ta'limdan chetda qoldirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a mark that shows the quality of a student's work
words.exampleEn: He worked hard all year to improve his grades.
words.exampleUz: U baholarini yaxshilash uchun yil bo'yi ko'p mehnat qildi.

words.definitionEn: to leave school or university before finishing
words.exampleEn: Many students drop out because they cannot afford the fees.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p talabalar to'lovni ko'tara olmagani uchun o'qishni tashlab ketadi.

words.definitionEn: a formal talk given to a group of students
words.exampleEn: Recorded lectures allow students to study at their own pace.
words.exampleUz: Yozib olingan ma'ruzalar talabalarga o'z sur'atida o'qish imkonini beradi.

words.definitionEn: a teacher who works with one student or a small group
words.exampleEn: Most parents hire a private tutor before the entrance exam.
words.exampleUz: Ko'pchilik ota-onalar kirish imtihonidan oldin xususiy repetitor yollaydi.

words.definitionEn: studying at home using the internet instead of attending classes
words.exampleEn: Distance learning gives rural students access to good teachers.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ta'lim qishloq o'quvchilariga yaxshi o'qituvchilarga yo'l ochadi.

words.definitionEn: to reach the same level as others after being behind
words.exampleEn: Extra lessons help weaker pupils catch up with the class.
words.exampleUz: Qo'shimcha darslar zaifroq o'quvchilarga sinfga yetib olishga yordam beradi.

words.definitionEn: to make less progress than other people
words.exampleEn: Children with no internet at home quickly fall behind.
words.exampleUz: Uyda interneti yo'q bolalar tez ortda qoladi.

words.definitionEn: a test you must pass to be accepted by a school or university
words.exampleEn: The entrance exam decides the whole future of a school leaver.
words.exampleUz: Kirish imtihoni maktab bitiruvchisining butun kelajagini hal qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the way in which a subject is taught
words.exampleEn: Modern teaching methods focus on communication, not memorising.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy o'qitish uslublari yodlashga emas, muloqotga qaratilgan.

words.definitionEn: a book used for studying a subject at school
words.exampleEn: The textbooks still in use were printed fifteen years ago.
words.exampleUz: Hamon foydalanilayotgan darsliklar o'n besh yil oldin chop etilgan.

words.definitionEn: a list showing when lessons take place
words.exampleEn: A crowded timetable leaves no room for sport or art.
words.exampleUz: Zich dars jadvali sport yoki san'atga joy qoldirmaydi.

words.definitionEn: the number of pupils taught together in one room
words.exampleEn: Smaller class sizes allow teachers to help every child.
words.exampleUz: Sinfdagi o'quvchilar sonining kamayishi o'qituvchiga har bir bolaga yordam berish imkonini beradi.

words.definitionEn: the fact of being present at lessons
words.exampleEn: Attendance drops sharply during the harvest season.
words.exampleUz: Hosil yig'im mavsumida davomat keskin pasayadi.

words.definitionEn: the percentage of people who succeed in an exam
words.exampleEn: The school boasts a ninety percent pass rate.
words.exampleUz: Maktab to'qson foizlik o'tish ko'rsatkichi bilan faxrlanadi.

words.definitionEn: a school that is paid for by the government
words.exampleEn: State schools are free but often badly overcrowded.
words.exampleUz: Davlat maktablari bepul, lekin ko'pincha juda to'lib ketgan.

words.definitionEn: a school that parents have to pay for
words.exampleEn: Only wealthy families can afford a private school.
words.exampleUz: Faqat badavlat oilalar xususiy maktabni ko'tara oladi.

words.definitionEn: a young person who has just finished school
words.exampleEn: Many school leavers have no idea what to study next.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p maktab bitiruvchilari keyin nima o'qishni bilmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to act dishonestly in an exam in order to succeed
words.exampleEn: Students who cheat in exams learn nothing at all.
words.exampleUz: Imtihonda ko'chiradigan o'quvchilar mutlaqo hech nima o'rganmaydi.

words.definitionEn: learning on your own without a teacher
words.exampleEn: Free online courses have made self-study realistic for everyone.
words.exampleUz: Bepul onlayn kurslar mustaqil o'rganishni hamma uchun real qildi.

words.definitionEn: learning by repeating something until you remember it, without understanding
words.exampleEn: Rote learning produces high test scores but little real understanding.
words.exampleUz: Yodlab o'rganish yuqori test natijasini beradi, ammo haqiqiy tushunish kam bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: not part of the normal course of study
words.exampleEn: Extracurricular activities develop teamwork and confidence.
words.exampleUz: Darsdan tashqari mashg'ulotlar jamoada ishlash va o'ziga ishonchni rivojlantiradi.

words.definitionEn: the skill of judging ideas carefully instead of simply accepting them
words.exampleEn: Our schools rarely teach critical thinking.
words.exampleUz: Maktablarimizda tanqidiy fikrlash kamdan-kam o'rgatiladi.

words.definitionEn: the theory and practice of teaching
words.exampleEn: Teacher training should be based on modern pedagogy.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar tayyorlash zamonaviy pedagogikaga asoslanishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a natural ability to learn or do something well
words.exampleEn: The test measures aptitude for languages rather than memorised knowledge.
words.exampleUz: Test yodlangan bilimni emas, tillarga bo'lgan layoqatni o'lchaydi.

words.definitionEn: the level of achievement a learner reaches
words.exampleEn: Attainment in rural schools remains below the national average.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq maktablarida o'zlashtirish darajasi milliy o'rtachadan past bo'lib qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a system in which people succeed because of ability, not money or family
words.exampleEn: Free entrance exams are meant to create a meritocracy.
words.exampleUz: Bepul kirish imtihonlari meritokratiya yaratish uchun mo'ljallangan.

words.definitionEn: staying away from school without permission
words.exampleEn: Truancy is a growing problem in large city schools.
words.exampleUz: Sababsiz darsni qoldirish yirik shahar maktablarida o'sib borayotgan muammo.

words.definitionEn: to do less well than you are able to
words.exampleEn: Bright pupils often underachieve in overcrowded classes.
words.exampleUz: Iqtidorli o'quvchilar to'lib ketgan sinflarda ko'pincha imkoniyatidan past natija ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to gradually put an idea or attitude into someone's mind
words.exampleEn: Good schools instil a love of reading in children.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi maktablar bolalarga kitob o'qish muhabbatini singdiradi.

words.definitionEn: to help a skill, feeling or idea to develop
words.exampleEn: Group projects foster cooperation among students.
words.exampleUz: Guruh loyihalari talabalar o'rtasida hamkorlikni rivojlantiradi.

words.definitionEn: to stop something from developing or being expressed
words.exampleEn: Constant exam pressure can stifle creativity.
words.exampleUz: Doimiy imtihon bosimi ijodkorlikni so'ndirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: having a wide range of skills, interests and experience
words.exampleEn: Education should produce well-rounded individuals, not exam machines.
words.exampleUz: Ta'lim imtihon mashinalarini emas, har tomonlama rivojlangan shaxslarni tarbiyalashi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the habit of continuing to study throughout your adult life
words.exampleEn: Rapid technological change makes lifelong learning necessary.
words.exampleUz: Texnologiyaning tez o'zgarishi umr bo'yi o'rganishni zaruriy qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the ability to do something to a good standard
words.exampleEn: The new system assesses competence rather than memory.
words.exampleUz: Yangi tizim xotirani emas, amaliy malakani baholaydi.

words.definitionEn: made or adapted for a particular person or need
words.exampleEn: Online platforms offer lessons tailored to each learner's level.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn platformalar har bir o'quvchining darajasiga moslashtirilgan darslarni taklif qiladi.

words.definitionEn: considering the whole of something rather than separate parts
words.exampleEn: A holistic approach to education includes health and emotions.
words.exampleUz: Ta'limga yaxlit yondashuv sog'liq va his-tuyg'ularni ham qamrab oladi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of teaching children at home instead of at school
words.exampleEn: Homeschooling suits some children but limits social contact.
words.exampleUz: Uyda ta'lim ba'zi bolalarga mos keladi, lekin ijtimoiy muloqotni cheklaydi.

words.definitionEn: learning a lot of facts quickly just before an exam
words.exampleEn: Cramming the night before rarely leads to lasting knowledge.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon arafasida tunda shoshib yodlash kamdan-kam mustahkam bilim beradi.

words.definitionEn: to give learners information without making them think for themselves
words.exampleEn: Teachers who spoon-feed answers produce passive students.
words.exampleUz: Javoblarni tayyor holda berib qo'yadigan o'qituvchilar sust o'quvchi yetishtiradi.

words.definitionEn: the condition of being extremely overweight
words.exampleEn: Childhood obesity has doubled in the last twenty years.
words.exampleUz: Bolalar semizligi so'nggi yigirma yilda ikki barobar oshdi.

words.definitionEn: the condition of a person's mind and emotions
words.exampleEn: Universities should offer free mental health support.
words.exampleUz: Universitetlar bepul ruhiy salomatlik yordamini taklif qilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the process of getting the food needed for health and growth
words.exampleEn: Poor nutrition in childhood affects the whole of later life.
words.exampleUz: Bolalikdagi yomon ovqatlanish keyingi butun hayotga ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: food that has been changed in a factory before being sold
words.exampleEn: Cheap processed food is full of salt and sugar.
words.exampleUz: Arzon qayta ishlangan oziq-ovqat tuz va shakarga to'la.

words.definitionEn: the amount of food or a substance taken into the body
words.exampleEn: Doctors advise cutting your daily sugar intake.
words.exampleUz: Shifokorlar kunlik shakar iste'mol miqdorini kamaytirishni maslahat beradi.

words.definitionEn: worry and tension caused by a difficult situation
words.exampleEn: Long working hours are a major source of stress.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq ish soatlari stressning asosiy manbai.

words.definitionEn: the condition of being unable to sleep
words.exampleEn: Using your phone late at night can cause insomnia.
words.exampleUz: Kechqurun kech telefondan foydalanish uyqusizlikka olib kelishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: the state of being unable to stop using or doing something
words.exampleEn: Smartphone addiction affects both sleep and concentration.
words.exampleUz: Smartfonga qaramlik ham uyquga, ham diqqatga ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the services that look after people's health
words.exampleEn: Free healthcare should be available to every citizen.
words.exampleUz: Bepul sog'liqni saqlash xizmati har bir fuqaroga taqdim etilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the act of giving someone a substance that protects against a disease
words.exampleEn: Mass vaccination stopped the spread of the disease.
words.exampleUz: Ommaviy emlash kasallik tarqalishini to'xtatdi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean
words.exampleEn: Simple hygiene rules prevent most infections.
words.exampleUz: Oddiy gigiyena qoidalari ko'pchilik infeksiyalarning oldini oladi.

words.definitionEn: the division of time between working and personal life
words.exampleEn: A healthy work-life balance reduces stress and illness.
words.exampleUz: Sog'lom ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanati stress va kasallikni kamaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: to stop eating, drinking or doing something completely
words.exampleEn: She cut out sugary drinks and lost eight kilos.
words.exampleUz: U shirin ichimliklardan butunlay voz kechdi va sakkiz kilo tashladi.

words.definitionEn: the condition of being physically strong and healthy
words.exampleEn: Regular walking is enough to maintain basic fitness.
words.exampleUz: Muntazam piyoda yurish asosiy jismoniy tayyorgarlikni saqlashga yetarli.

words.definitionEn: the body's natural defence against illness
words.exampleEn: Lack of sleep weakens the immune system.
words.exampleUz: Uyqu yetishmovchiligi immunitet tizimini zaiflashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: the sudden start of a disease in an area
words.exampleEn: An outbreak of flu closed several schools last winter.
words.exampleUz: O'tgan qish gripp keskin tarqalishi tufayli bir necha maktab yopildi.

words.definitionEn: a medical examination to check that you are healthy
words.exampleEn: A yearly check-up can detect problems at an early stage.
words.exampleUz: Yillik tibbiy ko'rik muammolarni erta bosqichda aniqlashi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: food that is quick to prepare but bad for your health
words.exampleEn: Advertising junk food to children should be restricted.
words.exampleUz: Bolalarga zararli tez ovqat reklamasini cheklash kerak.

words.definitionEn: heavier than is healthy
words.exampleEn: One in three adults in the city is now overweight.
words.exampleUz: Shahardagi har uch kattadan biri endi ortiqcha vaznli.

words.definitionEn: a unit for measuring the energy contained in food
words.exampleEn: A single sweet drink can contain two hundred calories.
words.exampleUz: Bitta shirin ichimlikda ikki yuz kaloriya bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: lasting for a long time and difficult to cure
words.exampleEn: Chronic diseases now account for most deaths worldwide.
words.exampleUz: Surunkali kasalliklar hozir dunyodagi o'limlarning ko'pini tashkil qiladi.

words.definitionEn: involving a lot of sitting and very little exercise
words.exampleEn: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of diabetes.
words.exampleUz: Kam harakatli turmush tarzi diabet xavfini oshiradi.

words.definitionEn: extreme tiredness caused by working too hard for too long
words.exampleEn: Teachers are leaving the profession because of burnout.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar kuyish sababli kasbdan ketmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the number of years a person is likely to live
words.exampleEn: Life expectancy has risen sharply since 1990.
words.exampleUz: O'rtacha umr ko'rish davomiyligi 1990-yildan beri keskin oshdi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of avoiding extremes, especially in eating or drinking
words.exampleEn: Sweets are not harmful if they are eaten in moderation.
words.exampleUz: Shirinliklar me'yorida iste'mol qilinsa zararli emas.

words.definitionEn: likely to be affected by an illness or influence
words.exampleEn: Elderly people are far more susceptible to infection.
words.exampleUz: Keksa odamlar infeksiyaga ancha moyil.

words.definitionEn: to become worse over time
words.exampleEn: His health deteriorated rapidly after the operation.
words.exampleUz: Operatsiyadan keyin uning sog'lig'i tez yomonlashdi.

words.definitionEn: to make pain or a problem less severe
words.exampleEn: Regular exercise can alleviate mild depression.
words.exampleUz: Muntazam jismoniy mashq yengil depressiyani yengillashtirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: intended to stop something bad from happening
words.exampleEn: Preventive medicine is far cheaper than treating the sick.
words.exampleUz: Profilaktik tibbiyot kasallarni davolashdan ancha arzon.

words.definitionEn: long life
words.exampleEn: Diet and daily movement are the keys to longevity.
words.exampleUz: Ovqatlanish va kundalik harakat — uzoq umr ko'rishning kaliti.

words.definitionEn: the feeling of being satisfied with your own abilities and worth
words.exampleEn: Constant comparison on social media damages teenagers' self-esteem.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi doimiy taqqoslash o'smirlarning o'ziga ishonchiga zarar yetkazadi.

words.definitionEn: connected with thinking, learning and understanding
words.exampleEn: Poor sleep harms cognitive performance at school.
words.exampleUz: Yomon uyqu maktabdagi aqliy faoliyatga zarar yetkazadi.

words.definitionEn: likely to suffer from something bad
words.exampleEn: People who skip breakfast are prone to overeating later in the day.
words.exampleUz: Nonushtani o'tkazib yuboradiganlar kun davomida ko'p yeyishga moyil.

words.definitionEn: the state of not having enough sleep over a period of time
words.exampleEn: Sleep deprivation is common among night-shift workers.
words.exampleUz: Uyqu yetishmovchiligi tungi smenada ishlaydiganlar orasida keng tarqalgan.

words.definitionEn: the number of deaths in a population over a period of time
words.exampleEn: Infant mortality rates have fallen dramatically since independence.
words.exampleUz: Mustaqillikdan beri chaqaloqlar o'limi darajasi keskin pasaydi.

words.definitionEn: a disease or problem that spreads quickly among many people
words.exampleEn: Doctors now describe obesity as a modern epidemic.
words.exampleUz: Shifokorlar endi semizlikni zamonaviy epidemiya deb ataydi.

words.definitionEn: testing people for a disease before any symptoms appear
words.exampleEn: Regular screening saves thousands of lives each year.
words.exampleUz: Muntazam skrining har yili minglab hayotni saqlab qoladi.

words.definitionEn: poor health caused by not eating enough good food
words.exampleEn: Malnutrition still affects children in the poorest regions.
words.exampleUz: To'yib ovqatlanmaslik hamon eng kambag'al hududlardagi bolalarga ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: an extra tax on sweet drinks intended to reduce consumption
words.exampleEn: A sugar tax cut sales of fizzy drinks by a fifth.
words.exampleUz: Shakar solig'i gazli ichimliklar savdosini beshdan biriga kamaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of looking after your own health and state of mind
words.exampleEn: Self-care is not selfishness; it prevents complete collapse.
words.exampleUz: O'ziga g'amxo'rlik qilish xudbinlik emas; u butunlay holdan toyishning oldini oladi.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which roads are too full of vehicles
words.exampleEn: Traffic congestion costs the city millions of working hours a year.
words.exampleUz: Yo'l tirbandligi shaharga yiliga millionlab ish soatiga tushadi.

words.definitionEn: an area on the edge of a city where people live
words.exampleEn: Families move to the suburbs in search of cheaper housing.
words.exampleUz: Oilalar arzonroq uy-joy izlab shahar chekkasidagi mavzelarga ko'chib o'tadi.

words.definitionEn: a person who is walking in a street
words.exampleEn: Wide, fast roads make life dangerous for pedestrians.
words.exampleUz: Keng va tez yo'llar piyodalar uchun hayotni xavfli qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a part of the road that is only for bicycles
words.exampleEn: Building cycle lanes would take thousands of cars off the road.
words.exampleUz: Velosiped yo'laklarini qurish yo'ldan minglab mashinani olib chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: the money you pay to travel on public transport
words.exampleEn: Cheap fares encourage people to leave the car at home.
words.exampleUz: Arzon yo'lkira odamlarni mashinani uyda qoldirishga undaydi.

words.definitionEn: the busy time when people are travelling to or from work
words.exampleEn: Avoid the metro during the evening rush hour.
words.exampleUz: Kechki tig'iz soatlarda metroga tushmaganingiz ma'qul.

words.definitionEn: containing too many people or things
words.exampleEn: Buses are overcrowded simply because there are too few of them.
words.exampleUz: Avtobuslar shunchaki juda kam bo'lgani uchun haddan ortiq to'la.

words.definitionEn: the houses and flats that people live in
words.exampleEn: The city urgently needs cheap housing for young families.
words.exampleUz: Shaharga yosh oilalar uchun arzon uy-joy zudlik bilan kerak.

words.definitionEn: having a large number of floors
words.exampleEn: High-rise blocks have replaced the old neighbourhoods.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p qavatli binolar eski mahallalar o'rnini egalladi.

words.definitionEn: a person who lives in a particular place
words.exampleEn: Local residents protested against the new motorway.
words.exampleUz: Mahalliy aholi yangi avtomagistralga qarshi norozilik bildirdi.

words.definitionEn: a building or service provided for people to use
words.exampleEn: The district has no sports facilities for teenagers.
words.exampleUz: Tumanda o'smirlar uchun sport obyektlari yo'q.

words.definitionEn: the measures that protect people from traffic accidents
words.exampleEn: Road safety should be taught in every primary school.
words.exampleUz: Yo'l xavfsizligi har bir boshlang'ich maktabda o'rgatilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: harmful or annoying levels of noise in a place
words.exampleEn: Noise pollution from traffic disturbs people's sleep.
words.exampleUz: Transportdan chiqadigan shovqin odamlarning uyqusini buzadi.

words.definitionEn: buses, trains and other transport available to everyone
words.exampleEn: Reliable public transport is the only real solution to congestion.
words.exampleUz: Ishonchli jamoat transporti tirbandlikning yagona haqiqiy yechimi.

words.definitionEn: to make something larger in size or amount
words.exampleEn: The city plans to expand the metro network by 2030.
words.exampleUz: Shahar 2030-yilgacha metro tarmog'ini kengaytirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: an area where one car can be left
words.exampleEn: Drivers waste fuel searching for a parking space in the centre.
words.exampleUz: Haydovchilar markazda avtoturargoh joyi qidirib yoqilg'i behuda sarflaydi.

words.definitionEn: a part of the road that only buses may use
words.exampleEn: A dedicated bus lane cut journey times by half.
words.exampleUz: Alohida avtobus yo'lagi safar vaqtini yarmiga qisqartirdi.

words.definitionEn: a road built around a town to keep traffic out of the centre
words.exampleEn: Lorries must use the ring road instead of the narrow old streets.
words.exampleUz: Yuk mashinalari tor eski ko'chalar o'rniga halqa yo'ldan yurishi shart.

words.definitionEn: an area of grass and trees inside a city
words.exampleEn: Every new district should include real green space.
words.exampleUz: Har bir yangi tuman haqiqiy yashil hududga ega bo'lishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the outer parts of a town, far from the centre
words.exampleEn: The new hospital was built on the outskirts of the city.
words.exampleUz: Yangi shifoxona shahar chekkasida qurildi.

words.definitionEn: the uncontrolled spread of a city into the surrounding countryside
words.exampleEn: Urban sprawl is swallowing valuable farmland every year.
words.exampleUz: Shaharning tartibsiz kengayishi har yili qimmatli ekin yerlarini yutmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which traffic cannot move at all
words.exampleEn: One accident brought the whole city centre to gridlock.
words.exampleUz: Bitta avariya butun shahar markazini to'liq tirbandlikka olib keldi.

words.definitionEn: money that drivers must pay to enter a busy city area
words.exampleEn: London's congestion charge cut traffic by fifteen percent.
words.exampleUz: Londonning tirbandlik yig'imi transport oqimini o'n besh foizga kamaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: the improvement of a poor or damaged area of a city
words.exampleEn: The regeneration of the old industrial district created new jobs.
words.exampleUz: Eski sanoat mahallasini qayta tiklash yangi ish o'rinlari yaratdi.

words.definitionEn: with a large number of people living in a small area
words.exampleEn: The Fergana Valley is the most densely populated region in the country.
words.exampleUz: Farg'ona vodiysi — mamlakatdagi aholisi eng zich joylashgan mintaqa.

words.definitionEn: a useful feature of a place, such as a park, shop or clinic
words.exampleEn: New housing must be built close to basic amenities.
words.exampleUz: Yangi uy-joy asosiy maishiy obyektlarga yaqin qurilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: relating to a large city and the area around it
words.exampleEn: The metropolitan area now holds more than three million people.
words.exampleUz: Yirik shahar hududida hozir uch milliondan ortiq odam yashaydi.

words.definitionEn: to make a street open only to people on foot
words.exampleEn: Pedestrianising the old town made it far more pleasant to visit.
words.exampleUz: Eski shaharni piyodalar zonasiga aylantirish uni tashrif uchun ancha yoqimli qildi.

words.definitionEn: a system for moving large numbers of people around a city
words.exampleEn: Only mass transit can move so many commuters at once.
words.exampleUz: Bunchalik ko'p qatnovchini bir vaqtda faqat ommaviy transport tizimi tashiy oladi.

words.definitionEn: homes that people on average incomes are able to pay for
words.exampleEn: The council must build affordable housing near transport links.
words.exampleUz: Hokimiyat transport yo'llari yaqinida arzon uy-joy qurishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the process by which a poor area becomes richer and its old residents leave
words.exampleEn: Gentrification has pushed long-term residents out of the centre.
words.exampleUz: Jentrifikatsiya uzoq yillik aholini markazdan siqib chiqardi.

words.definitionEn: the arrival of a large number of people or things
words.exampleEn: The influx of newcomers has strained city services.
words.exampleUz: Yangi kelganlar oqimi shahar xizmatlarini qiynab qo'ydi.

words.definitionEn: to move power or activity away from one central place
words.exampleEn: Decentralising offices would reduce daily commuting.
words.exampleUz: Ofislarni markazdan tarqatish kundalik qatnovni kamaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: to treat something as more important than other things
words.exampleEn: Cities should prioritise buses over private cars.
words.exampleUz: Shaharlar shaxsiy avtomobillardan ko'ra avtobuslarni ustuvor deb bilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to make a problem or pressure less serious
words.exampleEn: A new ring road would ease pressure on the city centre.
words.exampleUz: Yangi halqa yo'l shahar markazidagi bosimni yengillashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: to officially demand a tax or payment
words.exampleEn: The city may levy a tax on cars entering the centre.
words.exampleUz: Shahar markazga kiradigan mashinalarga soliq solishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to provide what a particular group of people needs
words.exampleEn: New districts must cater for elderly residents as well as families.
words.exampleUz: Yangi tumanlar oilalar qatori keksa aholi ehtiyojini ham qondirishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a central place where activity or transport is concentrated
words.exampleEn: The station has become a major transport hub for the region.
words.exampleUz: Vokzal mintaqa uchun yirik transport uzeliga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: money that you pay to use a particular road or bridge
words.exampleEn: A toll on the motorway would help fund public transport.
words.exampleUz: Avtomagistraldagi yo'l haqi jamoat transportini moliyalashtirishga yordam berardi.

words.definitionEn: an area of a city where cars are not allowed
words.exampleEn: The car-free zone brought shoppers back to the old market.
words.exampleUz: Avtomobilsiz zona xaridorlarni eski bozorga qaytardi.

words.definitionEn: a document listing your education and work experience
words.exampleEn: Keep your CV short, honest and easy to read.
words.exampleUz: Rezyumengizni qisqa, rost va o'qish oson holda saqlang.

words.definitionEn: working from home instead of going to an office
words.exampleEn: Remote work saves employees hours of commuting every week.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ish xodimlarga har hafta soatlab qatnovni tejaydi.

words.definitionEn: working for yourself rather than for a company
words.exampleEn: Self-employed people have freedom but no sick pay.
words.exampleUz: O'zini o'zi band qilganlar erkin, lekin kasallik nafaqasi yo'q.

words.definitionEn: the series of jobs a person moves through during working life
words.exampleEn: Teaching offers a clear career path but modest pay.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilik aniq kasbiy yo'lni beradi, ammo maosh o'rtacha.

words.definitionEn: the certainty that you will be able to keep your job
words.exampleEn: Many young people value job security more than a high salary.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p yoshlar yuqori maoshdan ko'ra ish kafolatini ustun qo'yadi.

words.definitionEn: the place where people do their jobs
words.exampleEn: A safe workplace is the employer's responsibility.
words.exampleUz: Xavfsiz ish joyi — ish beruvchining mas'uliyati.

words.definitionEn: working fewer hours than a full working week
words.exampleEn: She took a part-time job while finishing her studies.
words.exampleUz: U o'qishini tugatayotib yarim stavka ishga joylashdi.

words.definitionEn: working the whole of a normal working week
words.exampleEn: He was offered a full-time position after the internship.
words.exampleUz: Amaliyotdan so'ng unga to'liq stavka lavozim taklif qilindi.

words.definitionEn: a letter sent with a job application explaining why you are suitable
words.exampleEn: A short, specific cover letter beats a long, general one.
words.exampleUz: Qisqa va aniq motivatsion xat uzun, umumiy xatdan afzal.

words.definitionEn: the person who is in charge of you at work
words.exampleEn: A supportive boss matters more than a modern office.
words.exampleUz: Qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan boshliq zamonaviy ofisdan muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: the ability of a group to work well together
words.exampleEn: Modern employers value teamwork above technical skill.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy ish beruvchilar jamoada ishlashni texnik ko'nikmadan yuqori qo'yadi.

words.definitionEn: the skill of using your working time well
words.exampleEn: Poor time management, not laziness, causes missed targets.
words.exampleUz: Maqsadlarga yetmaslikka dangasalik emas, vaqtni yomon boshqarish sabab bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: the ability to guide and direct other people
words.exampleEn: Strong leadership can save a struggling company.
words.exampleUz: Kuchli rahbarlik qiynalayotgan kompaniyani saqlab qolishi mumkin.

words.translation: bir vaqtda bir necha ish qilmoq
words.definitionEn: to do several things at the same time
words.exampleEn: Trying to multitask actually lowers the quality of your work.
words.exampleUz: Bir vaqtda bir necha ish qilishga urinish aslida ish sifatini pasaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: arriving or doing things at exactly the right time
words.exampleEn: Being punctual creates trust in a new workplace.
words.exampleUz: Vaqtida kelish yangi ish joyida ishonch uyg'otadi.

words.definitionEn: a strong wish to achieve something important
words.exampleEn: Her ambition is to open a language school in her home town.
words.exampleUz: Uning orzusi — o'z shahrida til maktabi ochish.

words.definitionEn: the pleasure you get from doing your work
words.exampleEn: Job satisfaction often matters more than a high salary.
words.exampleUz: Ishdan qoniqish ko'pincha yuqori maoshdan muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: time away from work because you are ill
words.exampleEn: Workers without contracts get no paid sick leave.
words.exampleUz: Shartnomasiz ishchilar haq to'lanadigan kasallik ta'tilini olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: the paid holiday a worker is allowed each year
words.exampleEn: Most staff take their annual leave in August.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p xodimlar yillik mehnat ta'tilini avgustda oladi.

words.definitionEn: made to work too much
words.exampleEn: Overworked teachers cannot give pupils real attention.
words.exampleUz: Haddan ortiq ishlab charchagan o'qituvchilar o'quvchilarga haqiqiy e'tibor bera olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: payment given for work that has been done
words.exampleEn: The post offers generous remuneration and full insurance.
words.exampleUz: Bu lavozim saxovatli mehnat haqi va to'liq sug'urtani taklif qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a formal meeting to judge how well an employee is working
words.exampleEn: Annual appraisals decide who gets a pay rise.
words.exampleUz: Yillik baholash kimga maosh oshirilishini hal qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the chances of future success in a job
words.exampleEn: The work is dull but the career prospects are excellent.
words.exampleUz: Ish zerikarli, lekin kasbiy istiqboli a'lo.

words.definitionEn: special skill or deep knowledge in a particular field
words.exampleEn: The country lacks expertise in green energy.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakatda yashil energetika bo'yicha chuqur bilim yetishmaydi.

words.definitionEn: an experienced person who advises and guides a younger one
words.exampleEn: Every new employee is assigned an experienced mentor.
words.exampleUz: Har bir yangi xodimga tajribali murabbiy biriktiriladi.

words.definitionEn: meeting people who may be useful for your career
words.exampleEn: Networking often matters more than formal qualifications.
words.exampleUz: Foydali aloqalar o'rnatish ko'pincha rasmiy diplomdan muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: a person who cannot stop working
words.exampleEn: He became a workaholic and lost touch with his family.
words.exampleUz: U ishga berilib ketdi va oilasi bilan aloqani yo'qotdi.

words.definitionEn: a system that lets workers choose when they start and finish
words.exampleEn: Flexitime helps parents manage the school run.
words.exampleUz: Moslashuvchan ish vaqti ota-onalarga bolalarni maktabga olib borishni yengillashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: the confidence and enthusiasm of a group of people
words.exampleEn: Unfair pay destroys morale in the whole office.
words.exampleUz: Adolatsiz maosh butun ofisdagi ruhiy holatni buzadi.

words.definitionEn: to reduce the number of people a company employs
words.exampleEn: The airline downsized sharply after demand collapsed.
words.exampleUz: Aviakompaniya talab keskin tushgach o'zini qattiq qisqartirdi.

words.definitionEn: the supply of workers and the jobs that are available
words.exampleEn: The labour market now rewards technical skills above all.
words.exampleUz: Mehnat bozori hozir eng avvalo texnik ko'nikmalarni qadrlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a system based on short-term jobs instead of permanent contracts
words.exampleEn: The gig economy offers flexibility but almost no protection.
words.exampleUz: Gig-iqtisodiyot moslashuvchanlik beradi, lekin himoya deyarli yo'q.

words.definitionEn: to have a strong desire to achieve something
words.exampleEn: Most graduates aspire to work for an international firm.
words.exampleUz: Ko'pchilik bitiruvchilar xalqaro firmada ishlashga intiladi.

words.definitionEn: the qualifications and experience that make someone suitable for a job
words.exampleEn: Employers check credentials far more carefully than they used to.
words.exampleUz: Ish beruvchilar malaka hujjatlarini avvalgidan ancha sinchkovlik bilan tekshiradi.

words.definitionEn: connected with work that involves physical labour
words.exampleEn: Automation threatens blue-collar jobs first.
words.exampleUz: Avtomatlashtirish avvalo ishchi kasblariga tahdid soladi.

words.definitionEn: connected with office work rather than physical labour
words.exampleEn: White-collar workers are now affected by AI as well.
words.exampleUz: Endi ofis xodimlariga ham sun'iy intellekt ta'sir qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: not paid enough for the work that is done
words.exampleEn: Nurses remain overworked and badly underpaid.
words.exampleUz: Hamshiralar hamon ortiqcha ishlaydi va juda kam haq oladi.

words.definitionEn: to learn or teach new skills for a different kind of job
words.exampleEn: Governments must help older workers retrain for new industries.
words.exampleUz: Hukumatlar keksa ishchilarga yangi tarmoqlar uchun qayta tayyorlanishda yordam berishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to learn additional skills for the job you already have
words.exampleEn: Employees who upskill regularly are rarely replaced.
words.exampleUz: Muntazam malakasini oshiradigan xodimlar kamdan-kam almashtiriladi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of giving jobs to relatives rather than to the best candidate
words.exampleEn: Nepotism discourages talented young people from applying.
words.exampleUz: Qarindosh-urug'chilik iqtidorli yoshlarni ariza berishdan qaytaradi.

words.definitionEn: newspapers, television and the internet as sources of news
words.exampleEn: The media shape public opinion on almost every issue.
words.exampleUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari deyarli har bir masalada jamoatchilik fikrini shakllantiradi.

words.definitionEn: words on the screen that show what people are saying
words.exampleEn: Watching films with English subtitles improves your listening.
words.exampleUz: Ingliz subtitrlari bilan film ko'rish tinglash ko'nikmangizni yaxshilaydi.

words.definitionEn: a traditional way of behaving in a particular society
words.exampleEn: Respecting elders is an important custom in our culture.
words.exampleUz: Kattalarni hurmat qilish — madaniyatimizdagi muhim urf-odat.

words.definitionEn: a special event at which people celebrate something
words.exampleEn: The Navruz festival brings whole neighbourhoods together.
words.exampleUz: Navro'z bayrami butun mahallalarni birlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: friendly and generous treatment of guests
words.exampleEn: Uzbek hospitality impresses every foreign visitor.
words.exampleUz: O'zbek mehmondo'stligi har bir chet ellik mehmonni hayratda qoldiradi.

words.definitionEn: websites and apps where people share content and messages
words.exampleEn: Social media spreads news far faster than television.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yangiliklarni televidenidan ancha tez tarqatadi.

words.definitionEn: a person who makes videos, posts or articles for the internet
words.exampleEn: Content creators can now earn more than television presenters.
words.exampleUz: Kontent yaratuvchilar endi teleboshlovchilardan ko'proq daromad topishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: watching or listening online without downloading a file
words.exampleEn: Streaming services have replaced the cinema for many families.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn efir xizmatlari ko'p oilalar uchun kinoteatr o'rnini bosdi.

words.definitionEn: to keep something in its original state so that it is not lost
words.exampleEn: Museums preserve crafts that would otherwise disappear.
words.exampleUz: Muzeylar aks holda yo'qolib ketadigan hunarlarni saqlab qoladi.

words.definitionEn: a public show of art or interesting objects
words.exampleEn: The exhibition of miniatures drew huge crowds.
words.exampleUz: Miniatyuralar ko'rgazmasi katta olomonni jalb qildi.

words.definitionEn: a person whose behaviour others try to copy
words.exampleEn: Bloggers have become role models for many teenagers.
words.exampleUz: Blogerlar ko'p o'smirlar uchun namunaga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: a person with many online followers who affects their choices
words.exampleEn: Influencers now sell more than television advertising does.
words.exampleUz: Influenserlar endi televizion reklamadan ko'proq sotadi.

words.definitionEn: a recorded programme you can listen to online
words.exampleEn: Listening to podcasts on the bus improves your English.
words.exampleUz: Avtobusda podkast tinglash ingliz tilingizni yaxshilaydi.

words.definitionEn: a television station, or an account that publishes videos online
words.exampleEn: The channel changed its style to attract younger viewers.
words.exampleUz: Kanal yoshroq tomoshabinlarni jalb qilish uchun uslubini o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: a set of television programmes with the same characters
words.exampleEn: The historical series made young people read about the era.
words.exampleUz: Tarixiy serial yoshlarni o'sha davr haqida o'qishga undadi.

words.definitionEn: the traditional music of a particular people
words.exampleEn: Folk music is being rediscovered by young musicians.
words.exampleUz: Xalq musiqasini yosh musiqachilar qayta kashf qilmoqda.

words.definitionEn: an object made skilfully by hand
words.exampleEn: Tourists buy handicrafts that support whole families.
words.exampleUz: Sayyohlar butun oilalarni boqadigan hunarmandchilik buyumlarini sotib oladi.

words.definitionEn: an old building or statue of historical importance
words.exampleEn: The monument was restored with international funding.
words.exampleUz: Yodgorlik xalqaro mablag' hisobidan ta'mirlandi.

words.definitionEn: the difference in attitudes between older and younger people
words.exampleEn: Social media has widened the generation gap in many families.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ko'p oilalarda avlodlar farqini kengaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: a programme in which people from different countries share their cultures
words.exampleEn: Cultural exchange programmes break down old prejudices.
words.exampleUz: Madaniy almashinuv dasturlari eski xurofotlarni yo'qotadi.

words.definitionEn: presenting news in a shocking way in order to attract attention
words.exampleEn: Sensationalism sells newspapers but distorts the truth.
words.exampleUz: Shov-shuvga o'chlik gazetani sotadi, lekin haqiqatni buzadi.

words.definitionEn: false information that is spread, whether deliberately or not
words.exampleEn: Health misinformation spreads fastest during a crisis.
words.exampleUz: Sog'liq haqidagi noto'g'ri ma'lumot inqiroz paytida eng tez tarqaladi.

words.definitionEn: a popular newspaper full of short, dramatic stories
words.exampleEn: The tabloids exaggerated every detail of the scandal.
words.exampleUz: Sariq matbuot janjalning har bir tafsilotini bo'rttirdi.

words.definitionEn: an article that gives the opinion of the newspaper itself
words.exampleEn: The editorial called for stricter media laws.
words.exampleUz: Bosh maqolada qattiqroq matbuot qonunlari talab qilindi.

words.definitionEn: to change facts so that they are no longer true
words.exampleEn: Selective editing can distort what a politician actually said.
words.exampleUz: Tanlab tahrirlash siyosatchi aslida aytgan gapni buzib ko'rsatishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to control people or facts unfairly for your own purpose
words.exampleEn: Algorithms can manipulate what voters believe.
words.exampleUz: Algoritmlar saylovchilar nimaga ishonishini boshqarishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to make something seem better or more important than it really is
words.exampleEn: Some films glorify violence and easy money.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi filmlar zo'ravonlik va oson pulni ulug'laydi.

words.definitionEn: the quality of being genuine and not a copy
words.exampleEn: Tourists look for authenticity, not copies of old buildings.
words.exampleUz: Sayyohlar eski binolar nusxasini emas, asllikni izlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to turn something into a way of making money
words.exampleEn: Traditional holidays have been heavily commercialised.
words.exampleUz: An'anaviy bayramlar qattiq tijoratlashtirilgan.

words.definitionEn: aimed at a small, specialised group of people
words.exampleEn: Streaming platforms have made niche content profitable.
words.exampleUz: Strim platformalari tor doiradagi kontentni foydali qildi.

words.definitionEn: to be attractive or interesting to a particular group
words.exampleEn: The channel appeals to viewers under twenty-five.
words.exampleUz: Kanal yigirma besh yoshgacha bo'lgan tomoshabinlarga yoqadi.

words.definitionEn: to become part of a larger group and adopt its culture
words.exampleEn: Young migrants assimilate far faster than their parents.
words.exampleUz: Yosh migrantlar ota-onalariga qaraganda ancha tez singib ketadi.

words.definitionEn: to make something popular or active again
words.exampleEn: The festival has revived interest in traditional crafts.
words.exampleUz: Festival an'anaviy hunarlarga qiziqishni qayta jonlantirdi.

words.definitionEn: an exaggerated headline written only to make people click on it
words.exampleEn: Clickbait headlines rarely match the actual story.
words.exampleUz: Chalg'ituvchi sarlavhalar kamdan-kam haqiqiy xabarga mos keladi.

words.definitionEn: a set of actions always performed in the same way on a special occasion
words.exampleEn: Wedding rituals differ greatly between regions.
words.exampleUz: To'y marosimlari mintaqalar o'rtasida keskin farq qiladi.

words.definitionEn: including people of several different cultures
words.exampleEn: A multicultural city needs schools that reflect its diversity.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p madaniyatli shahar o'z rang-barangligini aks ettiradigan maktablarga muhtoj.

words.definitionEn: the process of becoming more like Western countries in culture
words.exampleEn: Older people see westernisation as a threat to tradition.
words.exampleUz: Keksalar g'arblashuvni an'anaga tahdid deb biladi.

words.definitionEn: the replacing of the original voices in a film with another language
words.exampleEn: Poor dubbing spoils even the best film.
words.exampleUz: Yomon dublyaj hatto eng yaxshi filmni ham buzadi.

words.definitionEn: exaggerated publicity intended to create excitement
words.exampleEn: The film failed to live up to the hype.
words.exampleUz: Film shov-shuvli reklamani oqlay olmadi.

words.definitionEn: to make something seem less serious or important than it really is
words.exampleEn: Short videos trivialise complex political issues.
words.exampleUz: Qisqa videolar murakkab siyosiy masalalarni arzimas qilib ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: a person forced to leave their country because of war or danger
words.exampleEn: Neighbouring countries have accepted thousands of refugees.
words.exampleUz: Qo'shni davlatlar minglab qochqinni qabul qildi.

words.definitionEn: help such as food and medicine sent to people in crisis
words.exampleEn: Humanitarian aid finally reached the flooded villages.
words.exampleUz: Gumanitar yordam nihoyat suv bosgan qishloqlarga yetib bordi.

words.definitionEn: a severe lack of food affecting a large number of people
words.exampleEn: Drought and war together caused a terrible famine.
words.exampleUz: Qurg'oqchilik va urush birgalikda dahshatli ocharchilikka sabab bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: a serious disagreement or period of fighting
words.exampleEn: The conflict has displaced almost two million people.
words.exampleUz: Mojaro deyarli ikki million kishini uyidan judo qildi.

words.definitionEn: the basic freedoms that every person should have
words.exampleEn: Access to education is a basic human right.
words.exampleUz: Ta'lim olish — asosiy inson huquqi.

words.definitionEn: the number of crimes committed in a place over a period
words.exampleEn: The crime rate falls when young people have jobs.
words.exampleUz: Yoshlar ish bilan ta'minlanganda jinoyatchilik darajasi pasayadi.

words.definitionEn: the use of violence to achieve political aims
words.exampleEn: Poverty and exclusion can feed terrorism.
words.exampleUz: Qashshoqlik va chetlatilish terrorizmni oziqlantirishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: a poorer country that is building up its economy
words.exampleEn: Developing countries suffer most from climate change.
words.exampleUz: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlar iqlim o'zgarishidan eng ko'p aziyat chekadi.

words.definitionEn: the number of babies born for every thousand people in a year
words.exampleEn: A falling birth rate creates serious problems for pensions.
words.exampleUz: Tug'ilish darajasining pasayishi pensiya uchun jiddiy muammo tug'diradi.

words.definitionEn: a society in which the average age of people is rising
words.exampleEn: An ageing population puts heavy pressure on healthcare.
words.exampleUz: Qariyotgan aholi sog'liqni saqlashga og'ir bosim o'tkazadi.

words.definitionEn: reliable access to enough safe and nutritious food
words.exampleEn: Climate change threatens food security across the region.
words.exampleUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi butun mintaqada oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga tahdid soladi.

words.definitionEn: an event such as a flood or earthquake that causes great damage
words.exampleEn: The country was hit by three natural disasters in one year.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakat bir yilda uchta tabiiy ofatga duch keldi.

words.definitionEn: the act of working together towards the same goal
words.exampleEn: International cooperation is essential for sharing water fairly.
words.exampleUz: Suvni adolatli taqsimlash uchun xalqaro hamkorlik zarur.

words.definitionEn: suffering or death caused by having no food
words.exampleEn: Thousands died of starvation before aid finally arrived.
words.exampleUz: Yordam nihoyat yetib kelguncha minglab odam ochlikdan halok bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: having nowhere to live
words.exampleEn: The earthquake left forty thousand people homeless.
words.exampleUz: Zilzila qirq ming kishini uy-joysiz qoldirdi.

words.definitionEn: a very poor and crowded area of a city
words.exampleEn: A billion people worldwide still live in slums.
words.exampleUz: Dunyoda bir milliard odam hamon qashshoq mahallalarda yashaydi.

words.definitionEn: the use of children as workers
words.exampleEn: Cheap clothes are often produced using child labour.
words.exampleUz: Arzon kiyimlar ko'pincha bolalar mehnati yordamida ishlab chiqariladi.

words.definitionEn: a rich country with an advanced economy
words.exampleEn: Developed countries produced most of the historic emissions.
words.exampleUz: Rivojlangan mamlakatlar tarixiy chiqindilarning ko'p qismini ishlab chiqargan.

words.definitionEn: the line that divides two countries
words.exampleEn: Closing the border hurt traders on both sides.
words.exampleUz: Chegarani yopish ikkala tomondagi savdogarlarga zarar keltirdi.

words.definitionEn: the state of men and women having the same rights and chances
words.exampleEn: Gender equality in employment is still a long way off.
words.exampleUz: Bandlikda gender tengligi hali ancha uzoqda.

words.definitionEn: the difference between the richest and the poorest in a society
words.exampleEn: The wealth gap has widened over the last decade.
words.exampleUz: Boylik tafovuti so'nggi o'n yilda kengaydi.

words.definitionEn: an official punishment imposed on a country
words.exampleEn: Economic sanctions hurt ordinary citizens most of all.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy sanksiyalar eng ko'p oddiy fuqarolarga zarar yetkazadi.

words.definitionEn: the art of managing relations between countries
words.exampleEn: Quiet diplomacy achieved more than public threats.
words.exampleUz: Sokin diplomatiya ochiq tahdidlardan ko'ra ko'proq natija berdi.

words.translation: miyalar oqimi, mutaxassislarning chet elga ketishi
words.definitionEn: the loss of skilled people who move abroad to work
words.exampleEn: The brain drain has left hospitals short of surgeons.
words.exampleUz: Miyalar oqimi shifoxonalarni jarrohsiz qoldirdi.

words.definitionEn: treated as unimportant and kept out of mainstream society
words.exampleEn: Marginalised groups rarely appear in the national media.
words.exampleUz: Chetlatilgan guruhlar milliy ommaviy axborotda kamdan-kam ko'rinadi.

words.definitionEn: the forcing of people to leave their homes
words.exampleEn: Mass displacement follows every major conflict.
words.exampleUz: Har bir yirik mojarodan keyin ommaviy ko'chirilish yuz beradi.

words.definitionEn: action taken in order to change a situation
words.exampleEn: Early intervention prevents small problems from becoming crises.
words.exampleUz: Erta aralashuv kichik muammolarning inqirozga aylanishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

words.definitionEn: to destroy or get rid of something completely
words.exampleEn: Vaccines have almost eradicated polio worldwide.
words.exampleUz: Vaksinalar dunyo bo'ylab poliomielitni deyarli butunlay yo'q qildi.

words.definitionEn: common in a particular place or at a particular time
words.exampleEn: Child labour is still prevalent in some industries.
words.exampleUz: Bolalar mehnati ba'zi tarmoqlarda hamon keng tarqalgan.

words.definitionEn: to become, or make something become, much more serious
words.exampleEn: A trade dispute quickly escalated into a political crisis.
words.exampleUz: Savdo nizosi tezda keskinlashib, siyosiy inqirozga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: angry protest and disorder among the public
words.exampleEn: Rising food prices led to widespread social unrest.
words.exampleUz: Oziq-ovqat narxining oshishi keng ijtimoiy notinchlikka olib keldi.

words.definitionEn: a formal written agreement between countries
words.exampleEn: Nearly two hundred states signed the climate treaty.
words.exampleUz: Deyarli ikki yuz davlat iqlim shartnomasini imzoladi.

words.definitionEn: too many people living in an area for its resources to support
words.exampleEn: Overpopulation strains water and land in the valley.
words.exampleUz: Aholining haddan ortiq ko'payishi vodiydagi suv va yerni qiynaydi.

words.definitionEn: involving ordinary people rather than leaders or officials
words.exampleEn: Grassroots movements often achieve what governments cannot.
words.exampleUz: Quyi bo'g'indagi harakatlar ko'pincha hukumatlar qo'lidan kelmaganini uddalaydi.

words.definitionEn: a group of countries or organisations working together
words.exampleEn: A coalition of charities demanded urgent action.
words.exampleUz: Xayriya tashkilotlari koalitsiyasi shoshilinch chora talab qildi.

words.definitionEn: easily harmed and in need of special protection
words.exampleEn: Aid should reach the most vulnerable families first.
words.exampleUz: Yordam avvalo eng himoyasiz oilalarga yetib borishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the work of preventing fighting between countries or groups
words.exampleEn: A peacekeeping force was sent to the border region.
words.exampleUz: Chegara mintaqasiga tinchlikni saqlash kuchlari yuborildi.

words.definitionEn: protection given by a country to someone who has fled danger
words.exampleEn: Families who flee war may apply for asylum.
words.exampleUz: Urushdan qochgan oilalar boshpana so'rab murojaat qilishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: the policy of protecting home industry by taxing goods from abroad
words.exampleEn: Protectionism saves some jobs but raises prices for everyone.
words.exampleUz: Proteksionizm ba'zi ish o'rinlarini saqlaydi, lekin hamma uchun narxni oshiradi.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which countries or people depend on each other
words.exampleEn: The pandemic revealed the interdependence of world supply chains.
words.exampleUz: Pandemiya jahon ta'minot zanjirlarining o'zaro bog'liqligini ko'rsatdi.
